item.title: Chart or table?
item.description: A piece I wrote in 2016 on the old blog, revisited ten years on — with the charts redrawn, and what I would put differently today. Read the full post on the novathesis blog.

item.title: A thousand stars
item.description: The novathesis repository has passed a thousand stars on GitHub — a good moment to look at what the number is actually made of. Read the full post on the novathesis blog.

item.title: Best Paper Award for João Realinho
item.description: My student João Realinho, who I co-advise together with Rui Claro (Layer8), won the Best Paper Award in the “Computer and Communications Systems Security (SSCC)” track of INForum 2026 (Postuguese Symposium on Computer Science), for the paper “User Behavior Profiling via Kernel-Level Telemetry and Lightweight Edge-Inference”.

item.title: Choosing which "list of…" gets printed
item.description: One option turns off the List of Tables, Listings or Algorithms — without editing the configuration file that registers them. Read the full post on the novathesis blog.

item.title: novathesis 8.3.0 — Stork: Flying International
item.description: The template leaves Portugal for the first time, with Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin, plus appendix labels, a way to skip individual lists, and a chapter-styles showcase. Read the full post on the novathesis blog.

item.title: novathesis 8.2.0 — Hummingbird: Travelling Light
item.description: A new school — Faculdade de Farmácia da Universidade de Lisboa — a build option to cap the PDF size, and a fix for AMS symbols under pdfLaTeX. Read the full post on the novathesis blog.

item.title: novathesis 8.1.0 — Peacock: New Plumage
item.description: The template is renamed to novathesis, gains a proper colophon page, and drops its last external dependency. Read the full post on the novathesis blog.

item.title: novathesis 8.0.0 — Swallow: Migration Season
item.description: Glossaries move to bib2gls — a migration every existing document needs — and pdfLaTeX builds get about three times faster. Read the full post on the novathesis blog.

item.title: novathesis 7.10 — Chinese abstracts, and ISEL
item.description: Abstracts in Simplified and Traditional Chinese, support for IPL/ISEL, and automated integrity statements for NOVA FCSH. Read the full post on the novathesis blog.

item.title: novathesis 7.7 and 7.8 — Declaring AI use, and three more ULisboa schools
item.description: A formal AI-usage declaration for your thesis, support for FCUL, IST and ISEG, and a new spine design. Read the full post on the novathesis blog.

item.title: novathesis 7.6 — Sustainable Development Goals, and seven new languages
item.description: SDG icons on the abstract page, seven more languages for covers and fixed strings, and the Palatino font styles. Read the full post on the novathesis blog.

item.title: Appointed Co-Director of UNINOVA
item.description: João Lourenço was appointed Co-Director of UNINOVA — Institute for the Development of New Technologies.
